gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.

gaps.explanation: pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The car broke ___ on the motorway.
The chairman walked ___ of the meeting when the press arrived.
gaps.explanation: 'Walk out of' = leave suddenly, often to show disapproval.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: Her honesty more than makes ___ for her lack of experience.
gaps.explanation: 'Make up for' = compensate for a shortcoming.
